g.text: Spacing is a circle, not a square: 30 ft is the side of the square inside that circle.
So the real reach is 21 ft, and a narrow corridor lets the heads sit 41 ft apart.
Only one reach circle is drawn; nine would leave no drawing to read.
Devices, spacing and the floor are fictional.
WHY 41 FT IS NOT A MISTAKE
S smoke F pull station NA horn/strobe
every point within 21 ft of a head
the 30 ft spacing holds to 28 ft
wastes the corners of the circle
